units.source_text: 恋慕浮舟的贵公子们闻知她家如此繁华，相与议论：

en.t: The young noblemen who longed for Ukifune heard how prosperous her household was and discussed it among themselves:

units.source_text: “这姑娘定然很可爱，相貌想必也很漂亮。”

en.t: This young lady must surely be charming, and her looks must be lovely too.

units.source_text: 他们把她说成一个美人，大家醉心梦想。

en.t: They spoke of her as a beauty, and all of them became intoxicated with dreams of her.

units.source_text: 其中有一人叫作左近少将的，年纪只有二十二三，性情温和，才学之丰富乃众所周知。

en.t: Among them was a man called the Sakon no Shosho, only twenty two or twenty three years old, gentle in nature and widely known for his rich learning and talents.

units.source_text: 然而，恐是由于缺乏豪华时髦之相的缘故吧，以前往来的几个女子都和他断绝关系了。

en.t: Yet perhaps because he lacked a splendid and fashionable air, several women he had formerly visited had all broken off relations with him.

units.source_text: 现在他非常诚恳地来向浮舟求婚。

en.t: Now he came to propose marriage to Ukifune with great sincerity.

units.source_text: 浮舟的母亲想道：“在许多求婚者之中，此人最为合格，性情温和，见识丰富，人品也很高尚。

en.t: Ukifune's mother thought, Among all her suitors, this man is the most suitable: he is gentle, knowledgeable, and of noble character.

units.source_text: 境遇比他更好的高贵子弟，对于我们这种地方官人家的女儿，即使是长得很美貌，恐怕也不会来追求吧。”

en.t: Young noblemen in better circumstances than his would probably never court the daughter of a provincial official's household like ours, even if she were very beautiful.

units.source_text: 因此常把左近少将寄来的情书交付浮舟，每逢适当机会，便劝她写含有情趣的回信。

en.t: So she often handed Ukifune the love letters sent by the Sakon no Shosho, and whenever the occasion was right, urged her to write a graceful and feeling reply.

units.source_text: 这母亲就自作主张选定了浮舟的女婿。

en.t: In this way, the mother chose Ukifune's husband on her own authority.

units.source_text: 她下决心：“常陆守虽然对她漠不关心，我定要拼着性命提拔这女儿。

en.t: She resolved, Even though the Governor of Hitachi is indifferent to her, I will risk my life to raise this daughter up.

units.source_text: 看到了她的美貌，决不会有人怠慢她的。”

en.t: Once people see her beauty, no one will ever treat her lightly.

units.source_text: 便和左近少将约定：今年八月中结婚。

en.t: She then made an agreement with the Sakon no Shosho that they would marry during the eighth month of that year.

units.source_text: 一面准备妆奁，细微琐屑的玩具等物，也都求其式样特别精美。

en.t: Meanwhile she prepared the bridal furnishings, seeking especially exquisite designs even for small trifles such as toys.

units.source_text: 泥金画，螺钿嵌，凡是做工精巧、式样优美的器物，她都藏起来，留给浮舟做妆奁；

en.t: Gilt paintings, mother of pearl inlay, and every utensil of fine workmanship and elegant design she hid away to keep as Ukifune's bridal goods;

units.source_text: 而把那些粗劣的物品给常陆守看，对他说：“这是好的。”

en.t: but she showed the inferior things to the Governor of Hitachi and told him, These are the good ones.

units.source_text: 常陆守不大懂得好坏，不管这样那样，凡是女子的用品，越多越好地收购进来，陈列在亲生女儿房里，堆山塞海，人都几乎走不出来。

en.t: The Governor of Hitachi understood little about quality, and whatever the item was, if it was for women's use he bought as much as possible, displayed it in his own daughter's room, and piled it up like mountains and seas until people could hardly get out.

units.source_text: 他又向宫中的内教坊聘请琴和琵琶的教师，来教女儿学习。

en.t: He also hired teachers of koto and biwa from the court's Inner Music Bureau to come and instruct his daughter.

units.source_text: 每逢教会一曲，他不论站着或坐着，就向教师膜拜，又喧哗扰攘地命人取出许多礼物来犒赏教师，使得教师的身体几乎埋藏在礼物中。

en.t: Whenever they had taught her one piece, whether standing or sitting he bowed reverently to the teachers, then noisily ordered many gifts brought out to reward them, until the teachers were almost buried in presents.

units.source_text: 有时教习华丽的大曲，于暮色清幽之时由教师与学生合奏，这常陆守听了也深受感动，泪流不止，胡乱地赞赏一番。

en.t: Sometimes they practiced a grand and splendid piece, and in the quiet of dusk teacher and pupil would play together; the Governor of Hitachi, hearing it, was deeply moved, shed endless tears, and praised them wildly and at random.

units.source_text: 浮舟的母亲略有审美修养，看到这种情状，觉得非常粗蠢，从来不跟着丈夫赞赏。

en.t: Ukifune's mother had some aesthetic refinement, and when she saw this behavior she found it extremely crude and foolish, and never joined her husband in praising it.

units.source_text: 丈夫常常恨她，对她说道：“你看不起我的女儿！”

en.t: Her husband often resented her and said to her, You look down on my daughter!
